prompt:
The chart below shows the number of visits made to public libraries in one region by five age groups in 2010 and 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Visits to public libraries by age group, 2010 and 2022
visual.alt: A bar chart comparing the number of annual visits five age groups made to public libraries in 2010 and 2022.

key_points: Total visits fall from 17.6 million to 14.5 million
The fall happens only in the three groups under 44; visits rise in the two groups aged 45 and over
The sharpest fall is in the 15-29 group: from 3.2 million to 1.4 million, more than halving
The group with the most visits changes: under-15s in 2010 (4.8 million), 60 and over in 2022 (4.1 million)
The 45-59 group is the closest to stable in both years (3.1 → 3.4 million)
common_mistakes: Describing the two years separately without comparing the age groups
Writing 'millions of people' instead of 'millions of visits' — the chart gives the number of visits
Not stating the split between rising and falling groups (the overall pattern)
Guessing at reasons ('young people prefer the internet') — this is not in the data
